subject: grid required to adjust legend width?

messages.author: 065110cca96a6373
messages.subject: grid required to adjust legend width?
parts:
Does the opts(legend.key.width) argument accept anything besides a
unit? If not, is there a built in way to create them in the new
ggplot2 or do we just have to load grid?

opts(legend.key.width = grid::unit(1, "cm"))

If legend.key.width does require a unit, just that function could be
made available using NAMESPACE directives:

importFrom(grid, unit)
export(unit)

Cheers,

Josh
